title: euodia knudsenii
intro: Euodia knudsenii, commonly known as Knudsen's Euodia or Taiwanese Euodia, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rutaceae, native to Taiwan. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its purported health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and alleviate symptoms of fever. Studies have shown that the bioactive constituents of Euodia knudsenii, including limonoids and alkaloids, possess therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties. The plant's extracts have been used to treat various ailments, including respiratory infections, gastrointestinal disorders, and skin conditions, due to its ability to modulate immune responses and exhibit immunomodulatory effects.
